name: litellm-cost-race
description: Test 3 on LiteLLM v1.103.2: the same budget under concurrency. Run with the t3-race key (max_budget $0.0005; README.md). Ten requests at once each reserve their worst case (~$0.00015) before any finishes, so only about 4 are admitted although ten would cost ~$0.0003 in total: the reservation trades unused budget for never overshooting. A second burst after the first has settled shows the freed budget.
